query: select top 60 pl_name,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,st_mass,st_masserr1,st_masserr2 from pscomppars where pl_orbper is not null and pl_orbsmax is not null and st_mass is not null order by pl_name
important_caveat: PSCompPars may combine values from different references and some semimajor axes may be derived rather than independently measured.
